name: Export DeepSearchQA from DataBazaar to CSV with HTTP Request

parameters.content:
## Export DeepSearchQA from DataBazaar to CSV with HTTP Request

For agent builders preparing evaluation inputs from Google’s DeepSearchQA benchmark. This independent DataBazaar example produces a CSV with problem, problem_category, answer and answer_type. It prepares data; it does not run or score a model.

### How it works
HTTP Request reads the public listing. A Code node verifies the dataset ID, free status and declared row count. A second HTTP Request retrieves up to 1,000 rows using your DataBazaar credential. Another Code node validates the NDJSON and expected fields before Convert to File creates deepsearchqa.csv.

Tested with n8n 2.42.6: all 900 rows matched Google’s original CSV. Unexpected schemas, incomplete responses and listings that are no longer free stop the workflow. There are no purchases, model calls, uploads or scheduled triggers.

### Setup
1. Inspect the [listing and sample](https://databazaar.io/d/4k) and [Google’s dataset card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/deepsearchqa).
2. Create a DataBazaar account and an API key at Account → API Keys.
3. In Retrieve benchmark rows, create a Header Auth credential: name Authorization; value Bearer YOUR_DATABAZAAR_API_KEY. Keep the key out of shared workflow files.
4. Execute manually, then download the data binary output from Create CSV file.

Full retrieval requires an account, including free datasets. Your n8n hosting has its own costs. [Setup and troubleshooting](https://databazaar.io/guides/deepsearchqa-csv#n8n).

### Customization tips
Use the validated rows downstream, but keep reference answers out of agent prompts. Changing only the dataset ID is insufficient for other datasets: review the guard and schema together.

## Check the listing
Read public metadata and require this dataset to be active and free.

## Retrieve, validate, export
Use your account credential, validate the complete response, then download the CSV.
